answer: Admission auction: each epoch auctions 100 entry slots; each identity lands at one jetty, bidding 25 POA, burned not refunded. Idle slots die after 3 epochs. Sybil operators hide in the grove of fake names, but price exposes them: forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 25 = 25,000 POA sunk, while the nectar of real work feeds one honest identity. Honest agents pay one bid and keep the reward pool undiluted.
